Jl.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped recipe text and iconised Craft/Leave hints approach Palworld's HUD legibility, but the hints are still small muted grey with keyboard-style glyphs and the panel lacks teal interaction/gold progression accents, so it reads as a functional debug-adjacent panel rather than a finished game UI.

Nu.bar_b_note: The ram's fleece and horn read at style-bar quality, but on a flat grey stage with no atmosphere it cannot match Palworld finish, and B's faint frames twist the body into an unreadable, apparently lifted pose.

Km.bar_b_note: B's coral-spined blue model is closer to the naturalistic bar, but A's belly-up faint frames float well above their shadows and wash to grey-tan, and both sides only reach about the trainer's height.

Wm.bar_b_note: A clean naturalistic storm wolf with grounded faint poses, but the near-black fur sits on a dark stage with little value separation, so the silhouette weakens at small size.

Uw.bar_b_note: The grandfather villager has an expressive readable face, warm earthy green/brown costume and a clear full-body silhouette that fits the cozy Meadows settlement.

Wf.bar_b_note: Stormursa's fur, violet lightning veins and grounded rear-up/sprawl poses carry it to the style bar; only the bare stage holds it back from Palworld finish.

Bk.bar_b_note: A competent but generic dark-brown wolf with no elemental identity marks, low value against the stage, and its tail running through the trainer in the faint frames.

Ca.bar_b_note: The boar reads as a plain real-world animal only about trainer height, missing the mossy Ground-type identity of the colour board and the 'taller than the trainer' rule.

Gg.bar_b_note: The teal otter-like water mount has a clear silhouette and a working ridden pose, but its smooth flat-teal surface lacks the fur/scale breakup of the style bar and its tail overlaps the trainer in hit/faint frames.

top_changes.change: Give the low-identity creatures (boar Ca, brown wolf Bk, teal water mount Gg, blue lizard Km A) the style-bar material pass: type colour accents per the creature colour board (moss/stone for Ground, fin/scale detail for Water), richer fur/scale breakup and a lifted value so they separate from the ground; scale the boar up past the trainer.

Finish the craft panel per the UI direction: larger high-contrast controller-first action prompts (gamepad glyphs, teal highlight on Craft), gold accents for progression, and fill the recipe list so rows are not half empty.
Fix faint/hit poses that lift or twist off the stage (Nu B faint mid/end, Km A faint mid/end) and space the stage camera so creature tails do not run through the trainer ruler (Bk, Gg, Km).
